name: Plaid
description: Plaid calls itself "the world's largest financial data network," enabling companies to connect to financial institutions and build fintech solutions on top of verified account and transaction data.
best_for: Plaid targets fintech companies, banks, lenders, payment processors, and organizations in consumer lending, insurance, healthcare, and gaming that need to build financial products.
features: Bank connections across 12,000+ financial institutions in 20 countries
Account and routing number verification (Auth product)
Identity verification / KYC and anti-fraud tools
Categorized transaction and investment data (up to 24 months)
Fraud-prevention network built on aggregated data points

alternatives.name: Stripe
alternatives.description: A payments and financial-infrastructure API for accepting payments and managing billing/subscriptions.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that need to actually process payments (cards, ACH, subscriptions) rather than just access bank data.

alternatives.name: Twilio
alternatives.description: Provides identity/verification APIs (Verify, Lookup) that overlap partially with Plaid's identity-verification use case.
alternatives.best_for: Companies needing phone-based identity verification or fraud signals alongside bank-data verification.

pricing.starting_price: Trial is free; paid production rates are product-specific and shown during Production access or by sales

tiers.name: Trial
tiers.notes: Free production evaluation with limited live usage; Plaid documents a 10-Item Trial limit.

tiers.name: Pay as You Go
tiers.notes: No minimum spend or upfront commitment; product-specific rates, pay only for usage.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: 12-month commitment with minimum spend, discounted product rates, support, SSO, and account management.

tiers.name: Custom
tiers.notes: Custom annual/volume pricing for larger or regulated deployments; includes broader product/support options.

cons: Plaid does not publish a universal numeric rate card: exact Pay-as-you-go and Growth product rates are shown during the Production-access flow, while Custom pricing is negotiated.
Billing varies by product—one-time per connected account, monthly subscription per connected account, or per successful request—and not every Plaid product is available on every plan.
